name: usine
description: An agent-agnostic software factory: an engine where loops — trigger → agent-run automations authored as files in git — run against many repos from one headless orchestrator.

scripts.check: node scripts/docs/check.mjs && turbo run check && pnpm --filter @usine/docs openapi:check && git diff --exit-code -- apps/docs/public/openapi.json
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tooling/test/*.test.mts scripts/docs/*.test.mjs scripts/release/*.test.mjs scripts/effect-diagnostics/*.test.mjs infra/hetzner/gateway/test/*.test.mjs infra/boat/test/*.test.mjs && turbo run test --concurrency=1
scripts.changeset:publish: pnpm build && pnpm stage publish -r --tag latest --no-git-checks && node scripts/release/tag.mjs
